intro: Magus Wordeen Voidglare praises your infiltration of the mages' city, and says the time has come to be more negotiatory. You are to carry the arcane mote you acquired to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... Negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?
Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
